extracted.intended_audience: research administrators, principal investigators, institutional grants offices, policymakers, and members of the public seeking a complete listing of NSF FY1982 program grants and contracts
extracted.subtask_description: A government report compiling a comprehensive listing of National Science Foundation program grants and contracts awarded in Fiscal Year 1982, organized by NSF program, geographic location, and institution, with key award metadata. It documents inclusion/exclusion rules and the report's internal organization/taxonomy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report scope
rubrics_metrics.description: This report is a listing of all NSF program grants and contracts awarded in Fiscal Year 1982 and is organized by NSF program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the overall purpose: produce a comprehensive catalog of NSF program grants and contracts for FY1982. (Used to delimit the dataset/timeframe covered.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: source appropriations
rubrics_metrics.description: This report includes all grants and contracts funded from the National Science Foundation’s Salaries and Expenses Appropriation and Special Foreign Currency Appropriation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only awards funded from these two NSF appropriations are included; other funding sources are excluded (see exclusions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: Program Development and Management Funds transactions
rubrics_metrics.description: The report generally excludes transactions funded from Program Development and Management Funds (such as procurements for routine housekeeping activities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Routine procurements or administrative procurements charged to Program Development and Management are not treated as program awards and are therefore omitted from the listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: awards using transferred funds from other federal agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: The report generally excludes awards (or portions of awards) using funds transferzed to NSF by other federal agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an award (or part of it) is funded by funds transferred into NSF from another federal agency, it is not normally listed in this FY1982 NSF-funded awards compilation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: administrative transactions without FY1982 obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: The report generally excludes administrative transactions such as extensions of project duration or amendments to modify grant or contract terms which do not involve the obligation of FY 1982 funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments/extensions that do not obligate FY1982 funds are considered administrative and are not included as FY1982 award obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization: program → geography → institution
rubrics_metrics.description: The listing is organized by specific NSF programs within topical areas; awards are arranged by state or country and, within each state or country, by institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary organization axis is NSF program area (e.g., Mathematical and Physical Sciences; Engineering; Biological, Behavioral and Social Sciences; etc.), then geographic grouping (state/country), and then by institution. A glossary at the end lists institutions by cities to aid lookup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program categories / topical taxonomy
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards are grouped under topical program headings and subheadings (examples include: mathematical and physical sciences; engineering; biological, behavioral, and social sciences; astronomical, earth, and ocean sciences; scientific, technological, and international affairs; Ocean Drilling Program and U.S. Antarctic Research Program; scientific and engineering personnel and education, and fellowships; special foreign currency; graduate and minority graduate fellowships).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this taxonomy when classifying awards in the listing; group awards under the appropriate program heading and subheading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award record fields (required fields per entry)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information provided for each award includes principal investigator(s), project title, award number, project duration, and amount awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each listing row/entry should include at minimum these metadata fields so readers can identify PI(s), project focus, funding reference, time span, and dollar amount. (This is the standard data schema for entries in the report.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Asterisk notation for multi-funded projects
rubrics_metrics.description: An asterisk following the award number indicates that the project is funded by more than one NSF program or appropriation and may appear more than once in the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an award is cofunded across NSF programs/appropriations, mark the award number with an asterisk and allow repeated appearances under the relevant program headings; readers should interpret repeated entries as the same project funded from multiple sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Glossary / institution cross-reference
rubrics_metrics.description: A glossary at the end of the book lists institutions by cities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an alphabetical/location-based glossary to cross-reference institution names and cities to help users navigate geographic and institutional organization of awards.
